**Estimating Effort Now**

I'm currently breaking down the software specification into actionable work breakdown structure (WBS) activities, focusing on technical decisions, design, and necessary assumptions. This initial phase will lay the groundwork for estimating each of the eight user stories in workdays.

**Estimating Effort Further**

I'm continuing to refine the work breakdown, focusing on user story U1 and U2. For U1, I'm evaluating the best approach to resolve the Teradata JDBC driver NPE, considering both connector support and custom configuration. U2's logging directory adjustment is straightforward, requiring property configuration and default handling.

**Refining Effort Now**

I'm continuing to refine the work breakdown, focusing on user story U1 and U2. For U1, I'm evaluating the best approach to resolve the Teradata JDBC driver NPE, considering both connector support and custom configuration. U2's logging directory adjustment is straightforward, requiring property configuration and default handling.

**Extracting Components**

I'm now breaking down the extraction tasks: the message-bus component into `spring-bus` (approx. 4 days), input/output type conversion into `spring-cloud-dataflow` (approx. 3 days), and the serialization codec into `spring-bus` again (approx. 2.5 days).

**Implementing New Features**

My focus has shifted to implementing a single-node XD Admin SPI using Module Launcher (estimated 5 days) and starting work on the Diego-based Receptor implementation.

**Investigating Service Registration**

I'm now investigating how Spring Cloud Stream modules can self-register with service discovery mechanisms like Eureka or Consul. My goal is to prototype this for better runtime orchestration within Cloud Foundry, estimating about 3.5 days for this technical exploration.

technical_and_design_decisions: Make the logging directory path in Spring XD configurable via a new environment variable/system property (e.g., `xd.log.dir`), defaulting to `${xd.home}/logs` if not specified.

Extract core message-bus and serialization codec components into a separate `spring-bus` project module and publish as Maven artifacts to allow modular consumption across Spring XD and related subprojects.
Move type conversion infrastructure directly into `spring-cloud-dataflow` to standardize module payload conversion.
Implement the single-node XD Admin SPI using Module Launcher within a single JVM process for local developer stream execution.
Implement the Diego/Receptor SPI by integrating with the Lattice/Diego Receptor REST API to manage module container deployment lifecycles on Cloud Foundry.
assumptions: Development environment includes access to Teradata instance/emulator and Cloud Foundry Diego/Lattice test cluster for verification.
The target code repositories (`spring-xd`, `spring-bus`, `spring-cloud-dataflow`) are configured with working CI/CD pipelines.
The developer has full access to repository management tools to extract and publish newly created libraries (`spring-bus`).
No major architectural changes to Module Launcher are required beyond standard SPI extensions.

activities.activity_name: Resolve Teradata Sqoop Job NPE and Integration
activities.activity_description: Investigate and resolve the NullPointerException when using standard Teradata JDBC driver in Sqoop batch jobs, and ensure seamless support for Teradata connection manager configuration (U1).
Modify logging configuration templates (Log4j/Logback) and system property resolution to support custom external log directories such as `/var/logs/spring-xd` (U2).

activities.activity_name: Extract Message Bus to spring-bus Project
activities.activity_description: Extract the message-bus core module from Spring XD into a standalone `spring-bus` repository, set up build configurations, and re-integrate into Spring XD as a Maven dependency (U3).
Migrate input/output type conversion capabilities from Spring XD to `spring-cloud-dataflow`, enabling custom domain object serialization and deserialization across streams (U4).
Extract serialization codec implementations from Spring XD to `spring-bus` and update dependencies in Spring XD (U5).
Develop a single-node (single JVM) implementation of XD Admin SPI leveraging Module Launcher for local execution of data pipeline streams (U6).

activities.activity_name: Implement Diego Receptor XD Admin SPI
activities.activity_description: Implement the XD Admin SPI using Diego Receptor client API for deploying and orchestrating Module Launcher instances on Cloud Foundry Lattice/Diego (U7).

activities.activity_name: Investigate Service Discovery for s-c-s Modules
activities.activity_description: Conduct technical investigation and build a proof-of-concept for Spring Cloud Stream modules self-registering to service discovery for runtime discovery and orchestration (U8).
Perform end-to-end integration testing across migrated components, single-node and Diego SPI implementations, and verify Maven build pipelines.
